evaluationRole: Historical replay already used during development; not untouched independent test or field verification.
people: Current first-floor registry proxy from frozen training mapping; four-zone allocation is an assumed west pattern.
weather: At every decision only current-slot weather is available to both adaptive strategies; it is held in each 30-minute projection.

plant.commonModel: Existing two-cabinet response model, two 28 kW nominal cooling / 9.18 kW label input machines.

baselineVariants.rule: When current floor people proxy is positive, permit both machines together at device setpoint 23℃; otherwise request both off. Basic device protection may delay the requested transition.
Same rule at device setpoint 24℃. Report separately; do not select the larger-energy baseline after seeing results.

adaptiveVariants.futurePeople: Persistence of currently known people proxy

lighting: All 42 × 18 W ceiling LEDs fixed on in this HVAC comparison; no lighting saving counted.
electricity: Only nominal HVAC input 9.18 kW × simulated compressor-ON duration per machine. Actual part-load, fans, standby, startup and measured bills unavailable.
qualifiedSavingRule: Both compared modes must pass every sampled occupied and empty temperature check and each of four end temperatures must differ by at most 0.05℃. Otherwise show raw nominal energy and temperature service separately, with qualified saving percentage null.
forecastIncrementalRule: Realtime and predictive must use the same V2 controller and plant; only next-half-hour people source differs. Do not ascribe all predictive-vs-baseline difference to forecasting.
knownLimits: No actual indoor temperature, first-floor seat occupancy, airflow, operating electricity or calibration. Strong mixing may change feasibility; report default and sensitivities together. No future actual weather or actual next-slot people enters a deployable decision.
